evidence: DESIGN_NOTES.md:74 NPC cascades pause at maxAutonomousCascadeHops (2) 'until a player or macro-world beat occurs (release_external_trigger)'; :100 elapsedWatches advance on Committed Time-Spend; :262 'Reading costs no watch. ... Everyone else keeps walking, and another NPC can still emit an ambient line'. PlaySession.ts:185 just steps the coordinator and pulses the scheduler each frame; release_external_trigger exists in WorldEffectSchema and reducer (WorldEffectReducer.ts:203).
note: Hop cap and no-watch-on-reading are accurate. Overstated in three ways: a 'player beat' can release chains (not only watch-spending macro beats); Clock 4 slow drift and Storyteller are designed on watches, which are unbuilt (05b), so macro beats' only source is a not-yet-designed-in-detail choice; and NPCs continue ambient behaviour and 2-hop chains while the player explores, so 'cannot propagate' is too absolute. The core design tension (world progress gated on committed time-spend) is real and the roadmap is open on it.
